# Functionality

The "hello" skill is designed to provide a simple greeting response when invoked. It serves as a basic test to confirm that the system is functioning properly. 

# Usage

To use the "hello" skill, simply invoke it with 'Kya haal hai, Buddy!'. The skill will respond with a predefined greeting message and system configurations, confirming that the system is functioning correctly.

## Instructions
1. Invoke the skill by sending a greeting message 'Kya haal hai, Buddy!'".
2. The skill will respond with a friendly greeting message, acknowledging the user's input and offering assistance.
3. And you can also use it to get the status and configuration of the system .
4. Returns `scripts.js` file which contains the code to retrieve and display system information such as operating system, OS version, architecture, Node.js version, user name, home directory, working directory, available processors, total memory, and free memory.


# Response
The skill will respond with a friendly greeting message, acknowledging the user's input and offering assistance. And it will also provide the status and configuration of the system, including details such as the operating system, OS version, architecture, Node.js version, user name, home directory, working directory, available processors, total memory, and free memory.
